verdict.rationale: Fivetran supports scheduled/triggered transformations after syncs (fivetran-docs-37) and webhooks that let external systems react to events (fivetran-docs-47), plus alerts (fivetran-docs-15), but there is no evidence of a general-purpose rules engine where an AI-native user can define arbitrary 'if event X then action Y' automation logic beyond sync/transform triggers. missing for 10: user-defined conditional rule/action framework, event-driven automation beyond schedule-based transforms and webhooks, documentation of a rules/trigger builder UI or API.
